messages.text: Yes — the 10" Illuminated Globe 4 Kids is a desktop model, sized to sit on a desk, shelf, or nightstand rather than the floor. It's illuminated with an AR learning feature, nice for a kid's room. Is this one for your own child, or a gift?
Good choice then — the AR feature lets them point a device at it to explore facts, which makes learning stick for kids. How old is your child?

That age is right in the sweet spot for this globe — simple enough to enjoy spinning and lighting up, with the AR app adding fun facts as they get curious about more detail. You can find it as "Replogle Globes 10" Illuminated Globe 4 Kids - Augmented Reality Feature" — just add it to your cart from that product page and you're set.
